Hanzo is a small team building an open AI cloud — the inference engine, the models, the backend services, and the agents that use them.
We review your resume and application materials
Get to know you and your experience
Meet the team and discuss next steps
The team is distributed. Work from wherever you already live.
We care what you ship, not what time you were online.
Few enough people that you own whole systems rather than tickets.
Most of what we build is open source, under your own name.
Remote, unless the work needs hardware in a room.
Work on foundational models, fine-tuning, and novel architectures. Experience with transformers, RLHF, and distributed training required.
Build high-performance inference engines and model compilers. Experience with LLVM, MLIR, or similar frameworks preferred.
Design and implement Model Context Protocol servers and tooling. Shape the future of AI agent infrastructure.
Implement zero-knowledge proofs for AI verification and on-chain compute. Experience with SNARKs/STARKs required.
Build scalable, high-performance backend services for our AI platform. Experience with distributed systems required.
Design beautiful, intuitive interfaces for AI products. Experience with developer tools and data visualization a plus.

For PhD candidates, graduate researchers, and student builders working on foundation models, compilers, cryptography, or autonomous agents. Includes free compute & API credits and full access to Hanzo Team for your research.
Don't see a position that fits your skills?
Academic Internships & Open Source Credit Grants
We always welcome and accept open-source contributors, PhD students, and independent researchers — with free compute credits and full access to Hanzo Team.

Pursuing a PhD, Master’s, or academic research in foundation models, compilers, post-quantum cryptography, or autonomous agents? Intern with our research and systems teams — or apply for academic research access to receive free API & compute credits and full access to Hanzo Team for your lab and research.
Open Source Contributors & Credit Grant Program

We always welcome and accept open-source contributors across our 122 organizations on GitHub and git.hanzo.ai. Ship pull requests, maintain integrations, or build open-source tools on Hanzo to receive free API, Cloud, and Dev credits plus Hanzo Team access through our Credit Grant Program.
If you have read the codebase and had opinions about it, we want to hear them.
